top_signals.title: U.S. East Asian envoy says investors are overpricing Taiwan risk, calls Xi a 'very rational actor'
top_signals.summary: Investors are overestimating the risk of conflict across the Taiwan Strait, a U.S. diplomat says, playing up deterrence to keep Beijing from taking the island.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: South Korea test-fires its first homegrown hypersonic weapon: presidency
top_signals.summary: The test comes just days after Pyongyang announced the AI-assisted launch of an intermediate-range hypersonic missile.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Maduro faces new charge of torturing U.S. citizens in custody
top_signals.summary: The new charges are the first added to the case since the capture of former Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro and his wife in Venezuela in January.
